shipped.title: HurleyUS/omadesign · 0.6.8 Craft parity released
shipped.summary: The craft parity stack (PRs #220 through #451) merged to master and shipped as Omadesign 0.6.8, the first stable release since 0.6.3. It rolls up the 0.6.4 to 0.6.7 milestones with the menu, channel, export, symbol, color and gradient work opened the night before.
bullets: Conic and shape gradients in the native float compositor
Gray and Lab tagged documents and Recolor reduction presets
Real commands in the Motion Animation, Layout, Develop and Effect menus
Spot ink channels, channel Calculations and Photoshop channel exchange
Asset Export bleed, JPEG quality, PNG-8, WebP and GIF variants
Symbol library import, in-place symbol swaps and linked graphic styles
shipped.when: Oct 20 · 9:02 AM EDT → Oct 20 · 9:54 AM EDT

shipped.title: HurleyUS/omadesign · 33 library test issues filed
shipped.summary: Right after the release, every deterministic library test failure was written up as its own tracked issue, covering nested layer copy, pinned file versions, keyboard focus routes, dock panes, the Photo develop workspace and a parallel test flake.
